newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Nov trade deficit forecast at 148 mln rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Nov trade deficit forecast at 148 mln rgt.

text.p: Malaysia is widely expected to report a deficit in its trade balance account in November, economists said in a poll by Reuters on Tuesday.

Economists from 10 research houses forecast an average trade deficit of 148 million ringgit for November, though their estimates varied widely, from a surplus of 700 million ringgit to a deficit of 700 million ringgit.
They also forecast that for the full year of 1996, Malaysia's trade deficit would be an average of 1.28 billion ringgit against the government's forecast of 5.2 billion ringgit.
The forecasts for the full year also varied sharply from a deficit of 2.5 billion ringggit to a surplus of 500 million.
Malaysia has reported a trade deficit of 954.35 million ringgit for the first 10 months of 1996. In October it reported a deficit of 773.4 million ringgit.
